Corollary
[existence for kappa solutions] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Corollary 36.1\group Kleiner–Lott Pseudolocality (cf. Corollary I.10.4) There are $\delta ,\epsilon >0$ such that for every $A>0$ there is $\kappa (A)>0$ with the following property. Under the hypotheses of Theorem 5.1, if $A^{-1}(\epsilon r_0)^2\le t\le (\epsilon r_0)^2$ and $d_t(x,x_0)\le Ar_0$, then the flow is not $\kappa $-collapsed at $(x,t)$ on scales below $\sqrt t$.
Proof
